pages.title: Degenerate Matter Ore
pages.text: End stone cracked around knots of matter so compressed that its electrons are packed into the lowest states quantum mechanics permits. Pauli exclusion holds it up, not chemistry. The block is far heavier than it looks, and the pick rings against it.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In the End, where dead stars seem to have been scattered, a pickaxe bounced off a seam of end stone that was much too heavy. Under the crust was matter pressed into degeneracy, like a fragment of a white dwarf.
$(thing)Found$(): in veins through the End (mine it for its drop).
